title: Parallel gradient boosting for flexible estimation of conditional distributions
abstract: arXiv:2607.13550v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Boosting is one of the most successful learning techniques for standard classification and regression tasks. Its extension to multi-output prediction problems has found an increasing number of applications in recent years. Among them is the prediction of entire conditional distributions rather than single functionals, which can often be framed as a multi-output regression problem, for example multiple quantile regression. Addressing such problems with classical implementations of boosting is computationally challenging, because usually one base model is trained for each target at every iteration. More efficient variants of boosting have been proposed to speed up training, but they tend to be tied to specific loss functions and classes of base learners, usually decision trees. In this work, we study a modification of the gradient boosting algorithm, which we call parallel gradient boosting, designed to circumvent all these limit

translated_title: 用于条件分布灵活估计的并行梯度提升方法
translated_abstract: 提升方法是标准分类和回归任务中最成功的学习技术之一。近年来，其向多输出预测问题的扩展得到了越来越多的应用。其中一个应用是对整个条件分布而非单一泛函进行预测，这类问题通常可以表述为多输出回归问题，例如多分位数回归。使用经典的提升方法实现来解决此类问题在计算上极具挑战性，因为通常在每次迭代中需要为每个目标分别训练一个基模型。为了加速训练，已有研究提出了更高效的提升方法变体，但它们往往局限于特定的损失函数和特定的基学习器类别（通常是决策树）。在这项工作中，我们研究了梯度提升算法的一种改进版本，我们称之为并行梯度提升，旨在克服上述所有限制……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种称为“并行梯度提升”的梯度提升算法改进方法，通过在每次迭代中仅训练一个基模型即可同时预测多个目标（如整个条件分布），克服了传统提升方法在多输出回归任务中计算开销大、且现有高效变体受限于特定损失函数和决策树基学习器的局限。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes "parallel gradient boosting," a modification of the gradient boosting algorithm that trains a single base model per iteration to jointly predict multiple targets (e.g., entire conditional distributions), thereby overcoming both the computational burden of classical boosting in multi-output regression and the restrictions of existing efficient variants to specific loss functions and decision-tree base learners.
